runtimeNotes: Use idle during betting-open and intro marks.
Use take_marks for the final 30 second startup phase.
Use sprint as the race locomotion base and layer stumble/nibble as event cutaways.
Use victory/loss in result announcements and replay booth closeups.

racers.laneStyle: explosive starter with dramatic corner leans
racers.scoutingReport: Fast enough to scare the tote board, but snack scent can break focus.
racers.personality: Impatient gate-snapper who keeps checking the rail for a launch lane.
racers.idleLoop: rapid nose twitch, paw taps, and a tiny forward lean
racers.startMood: crouches early and rocks twice before the bell
racers.winMood: does two punchy hops and stares down the finish camera
racers.lossMood: sits tall for a beat, then gives a single annoyed ear flick
